title: Wither
description: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], take 3 damage.
notes: Debuff status card that cannot be played from hand. Damages the player at the end of each turn if it remains in their hand. Has a special 'fake upgrade' mechanic where Wither.FakeUpgrade() increases damage by 3, but this is not a normal card upgrade (MaxUpgradeLevel = 0).
